title: Breeze Plasma busy indicator graphic looks kind of weird when it's not animating because animations have been globally disabled
line: With animations turned off, Plasma's busy spinner now shows a circular arrow instead of a still broken ring.
explanation: PlasmaComponents BusyIndicator just stops rotating the Breeze busywidget graphic when animations are disabled. That graphic is a ring with a gap and a tapering tail that only reads as "busy" while it spins, so frozen it looks like a broken circle (in the tray, Networks, Bluetooth, task manager launch feedback). The Breeze busywidget.svg gains a static variant (busywidget-static, plus 22-22 and 16-16 sizes) drawn as a circular arrow, and BusyIndicator uses it when animations are off and the theme provides it; other themes keep their usual graphic.

commits.message:
BusyIndicator: show a circular arrow when animations are disabled

With animations disabled the busy indicator stops rotating and is left
as a plain broken ring that doesn't read as busy. Breeze now has a
static variant with an arrowhead, shown when animations are turned off.

BUG: 522294

Same window with the fix: a circular arrow at every size
Notifications tray icon during a file job, animations off
Same tray icon with the fix

review.text: Showing an optional circular-arrow static variant in Breeze when animations are disabled is a great UX improvement, and the new SVG variants look crisp across all tested sizes and in the notifications tray. However, binding elementId directly to busySvgItem.svg.hasElement("busywidget-static") is not reactive to Plasma Style changes (KSvg::Svg emits repaintNeeded, not svgChanged) and relies on QML property evaluation order for imagePath; switching from Breeze to a theme without busywidget-static at runtime leaves elementId stuck on "busywidget-static" and makes the indicator render blank. Also, disabling animations live while a long-lived BusyIndicator is spinning leaves busySvgItem.rotation frozen at an arbitrary angle instead of upright.
changes: Make the hasElement("busywidget-static") check reactive to theme and imagePath updates (e.g. track a property or revision counter updated on busySvgItem.svg.repaintNeeded, busySvgItem.imagePathChanged, and Component.onCompleted) so switching Plasma Style at runtime falls back cleanly to "busywidget" instead of rendering blank.
Reset busySvgItem.rotation = 0 when animations are disabled/stopped for the static variant so turning animations off live does not freeze the circular arrow at a random angle.
Verify switching Plasma Style at runtime between Breeze and a theme without busywidget-static while animations are disabled.

reviews.text: This implements Nate's option 2 the way the reporter asked: when animations are off, it shows an optional busywidget-static element (a circular arrow, with 22/16 px variants). It's in the right place (the libplasma BusyIndicator plus the Breeze theme SVG that breeze-dark and breeze-light inherit), and themes without the element fall back cleanly. The screenshots show the frozen broken ring replaced by a readable arrow at every size and in the tray job indicator, and the animated path is unchanged. Small nit: the elementId binding calls svg.hasElement(), which doesn't re-evaluate on a theme change, but the bound longDuration usually triggers it anyway.
